requests.name: templates
requests.description: Retrieve all templates from the authenticated account.

requests.name: create html template
requests.description: Create an HTML_TEMPLATE (API/Claude only — raw HTML + CSS). Returns template id for create_pdf.

bodyHtml.description: Main HTML with Nunjucks placeholders. Use normal HTML/CSS; prefer webfonts from the shared Google Fonts list. No need to import these fonts as they are already included in the template.

settings.description: Optional page settings. pageSize: Letter|Legal|Tabloid|Ledger|A0-A6|Custom (default A4). orientation: portrait|landscape. customWidth/customHeight when Custom (e.g. 210mm). marginTop/Right/Bottom/Left (numbers, default 20), marginUnit (mm), printBackground (bool, default true), displayHeaderFooter (bool, default true), textDirection (ltr|rtl).

usedIn.description: Optional internal note for API source purpose.

requests.name: preview html template
requests.description: Render draft HTML with sample data. Returns JSON { success, html } — a self-contained document with Google Fonts + layout CSS. Does not save.

format.description: Response shape. Default html (text/html body). Set to json for { success, html } (MCP / API clients).

editorCss.description: If the template using is HTML_TEMPLATE, set to none (no SunEditor CSS). For WYSIWYG_TEMPLATE (SunEditor), leave unset so the default SunEditor stylesheet is included.

requests.name: get html template
requests.description: Load an HTML_TEMPLATE's HTML fields for editing.

requests.name: update html template
requests.description: Update an existing HTML_TEMPLATE. Partial fields merge into saved htmlTemplate. Preserves stored using.

requests.name: template placeholders
requests.description: Retrieve all placeholders from a template.

templateId.description: Template ID whose placeholders should be listed.

requests.name: create pdf
requests.description: Create a PDF from a template by filling placeholders with JSON data. The response typically includes a URL to the generated PDF.

templateId.description: ID of the template to render.

data.description: Placeholder values. Keys must match the template placeholders.

requests.name: Auth Check
requests.description: Verify that the API key is valid.

requests.name: current plan
requests.description: Retrieve the authenticated account's current plan name, active status, and PDF/template usage quotas.
